subfiles.about: The sheet refers researchers to document no. 69 in file 894.7961/7 concerning the differing legal status of the Kwantung Leased Territory and the South Manchuria Railway Zone.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Neville's 1931 communication distinguishing Kwantung's legal status from the Railway Zone's, prompted by Japanese flight restrictions.
